# Sample weld-repair procedure for offline discovery tests.

7.2 Major Weld Repair Procedure

The technician follows the major weld repair process for structural components.

1. Inspect crack
The technician shall inspect the crack and mark the extent of damage on the surface.

2. Remove damaged material
After inspection, remove damaged material from the affected zone using approved tooling.

3. Grind surface
Once the damaged material is removed, grind the surface to bright metal.

4. Preheat
Before welding, preheat the component to the specified temperature.

5. Apply weld passes
Following preheating, apply weld passes according to the qualified WPS.

6. Ultrasonic testing
Then perform ultrasonic testing of the completed weld.

7. Stress relief
After ultrasonic testing, perform stress relief of the repaired area.

8.1 Coating Touch-Up Procedure

1. Clean the repaired area
2. Apply primer
3. Apply topcoat
